title: Infrastructure as Code: Terraform & GitOps — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Multi-Environment Terraform Promotion Flow: dev -> staging -> production directory isolation using Cloud Foundation Fabric modules and least-privilege service accounts.
routing_rationale: Directory-level environment separation prevents accidental blast-radius leakage between development experiments and mission-critical production systems.

nodes.label: envs/dev/main.tf
nodes.detail: Deploys small e2-medium instances; auto-destroys nightly at 8 PM.

nodes.label: envs/stage/main.tf
nodes.detail: Deploys full multi-zone cluster mirroring production architecture.

nodes.label: Mandatory Peer Approval
nodes.detail: Requires approvals from Lead SRE and Security Officer before applying.

nodes.label: envs/prod/main.tf
nodes.detail: Provisions regional GKE cluster, Spanner multi-region, and Cloud Armor rules.

steps.title: Progressive Environment Promotion
steps.action: Changes tested in dev, promoted to staging for automated integration testing.
steps.why_traversal: Validates infrastructure code under realistic traffic before reaching production.

steps.title: Governed Production Apply
steps.action: Production deployment requires explicit cryptographic sign-off from designated leads.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents unauthorized or unreviewed changes from impacting live users.

scenarios.label: Emergency Direct Production Edit Disallowed
scenarios.root_cause: Engineer tried to bypass staging to apply hotfix directly to production Terraform.
scenarios.diverted_path: Branch protection rule rejects direct push.
scenarios.recovery: Follow standard hotfix pipeline through staging with expedited review.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Traces Multi-Environment Terraform Promotion Flow: dev -> staging -> production directory isolation using Cloud Foundation Fabric modules and least-privilege service accounts.
